name: x402-security-check
description: Checks an x402 seller's API server code on 11 items (402 contents, payment order, facilitator results, SDK advisories, ...). The skill reads the code; read-only MCP tools add evidence: SDK advisories in lockfiles, the live 402 and the token's EIP-712 domain, facilitator signers, Seller Probe purchase records, and the 25 x402 issues.
